_comment: Production. The required reviewer is the approval gate: a promote run pauses here until a human approves it, and GitHub records the result as a Deployment. prevent_self_review is false because on a single-maintainer repository the person dispatching the promotion is the only person who can approve it -- the same reasoning as the admin bypass in .github/rulesets/main-protection.json. Promotions are dispatched manually, so the workflow runs on a branch ref, not a tag.
